claims.claim_text: The indexed Charles Siragusa is a high-confidence match to official records documenting his Federal Bureau of Narcotics career and OSS assignment.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Charles Siragusa was assigned to the OSS from 17 March 1944 to December 1945.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A NARA-hosted official memorandum dates the OSS assignment; a DEA Museum history gives the same person's pre-OSS agency sequence.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact distinctive name, dated OSS assignment and consistent official career chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: The official memorandum dates OSS service from March 1944; the DEA source places Bureau service before it.
claims.match_notes: The NARA-hosted memorandum says the early-1940s Bureau agent was probably the same person; the independent DEA chronology strengthens but does not erase that qualification.

claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the exact name and mutually reinforcing official chronologies.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded rather than explicit recruited-from evidence.
claims.match_notes: The wording avoids claiming a formal transfer order that the accessible sources do not show.
